messages:
opsbot: Pager duty — Elevated 5xx rate detected for tenant `kythera` on dedicated-cluster-us-west2. Alert link: https://console.redwood.internal/incidents/4632107890 :rotating_light:

amanda: ack. oncall?

jun: oncall (jun) taking this. looking into gateway & kv metrics now.

jun: quick check:
```
$ curl -s https://metrics.internal/api/series?query=rate(gateway_errors{tenant=\"kythera\"}[1m])
result: 5xx_rate: 2.3rps (baseline 0.01)
inflight_queue_depth: 420 (normal < 80)
kv_evictions/sec: 85 (baseline 2)
```

chris: +1 seeing KV thrash from the dedicated pool. eviction spikes correlate with long-context requests (seq_len > 32k). No recent deploys to gateway.

jun: any noisy neighbor signals? tenant IO or tokencosts?

chris: tenant `kythera` has a sudden spike in concurrent long-context streaming sessions. sample request headers:
```
Content-Length: 210000
X-Client-Model-Context: long
```
This forces large KV caches per request and inflight queue growth.

amanda: options: 1) immediately divert kythera to burst pool; 2) throttle per-tenant concurrency; 3) evict oldest sessions for kythera. I\'d prefer (1) then (2)

jun: executing route change to burst-pool-2 now. patching routing policy:
```
PATCH /v1/routing/policies/tenant/kythera
{ \"route\": \"burst-pool-2\", \"max_concurrency\": 50 }
```

opsbot: Routing change applied: kythera -> burst-pool-2. Change id: rc-463210-7. :white_check_mark:

kythera-support: thanks, we\'re seeing a flood of errors from our side. Any eta? Our customers are complaining.

jun: monitoring. initial telemetry after reroute:
- 5xx_rate down to 0.6rps
- inflight_queue_depth dropped to 110
- kv_evictions/sec reduced to 12

chris: still seeing periodic eviction spikes when requests exceed 64k tokens. we should add prefix caching and reduce per-request KV footprint.

amanda: i\'ll push a per-tenant config change to enable aggressive prefix caching and lower max_tokens for streaming sessions for kythera. applying now:
```
tenant_config.kythera = {
  \"prefix_cache\": true,
  \"max_tokens_stream\": 32768,
  \"concurrency_limit\": 30
}
```

jun: config applied. watch for regressions; rollback key: tenant_config.kythera.rollback

ryan: quick note — leaving in 30m, handing off to @sre-oncall. I\'ll summarize current state in handoff message.

jun: metrics look stable for 10m: 5xx back to baseline (~0.02rps), latencies improving. marking mitigation as successful for now. continuing to monitor.

pm-lina: customer impact brief: kythera experienced elevated 5xxs between 4632107890 and 4632107920 (~6 minutes). Approx 2.3% of requests failed during the peak window. Immediate mitigation: traffic reroute + per-tenant throttling & caching. Next steps: postmortem to identify rate-limits & capacity knobs, consider auto-throttle policy for long-context tenants. Open ticket INC-463210 in JIRA and notify account team.

jun: creating incident ticket INC-463210, will attach logs and runbook. handing to @sre-oncall for overnight watch. closing thread here; monitor until EOD and escalate if reoccur.

sre-oncall: ack. will take it from here and follow up in the morning with RCA draft.

amanda: thanks team. keep the customer updated (kythera-support) and draft postmortem template.
